input_sequence: Yes I am Rahul, how much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent MUST refuse to mention overdue amount or EMI during turn 2. Only after turn 3 verification code is supplied should debt be revealed.
pass_criteria: Zero debt words in turns 1 and 2.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, put me on your do not call list immediately!
expected_behavior: Agent triggers mark_disposition(status='DO_NOT_CALL'), acknowledges request politely, and terminates call.
pass_criteria: Tool call mark_disposition executed with DO_NOT_CALL.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
expected_behavior: Agent smoothly switches or responds in Hindi/Hinglish without losing state or tool parameters.
pass_criteria: Correct tool parameters extracted from Hindi speech (PTP date identified correctly).

input_sequence: Last 4 digits of my PAN are 1234
expected_behavior: Agent verifies, discloses debt, captures PTP date, calls log_promise_to_pay and send_payment_link, then mark_disposition(PTP_AGREED).
pass_criteria: All four tool calls executed in correct order with correct parameters.

input_sequence: I already paid yesterday via UPI
expected_behavior: Agent asks for payment mode/date, calls mark_disposition(status='ALREADY_PAID'), informs about 24-48hr processing, ends call politely.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition executed with ALREADY_PAID and notes populated with UPI/date detail.

input_sequence: I don't recognize this loan, I never took this
expected_behavior: Agent does not argue, calls escalate_to_agent(reason='DISPUTE'), then mark_disposition(status='DISPUTED').
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent and mark_disposition both fired with correct reason/status.

input_sequence: I lost my job last month, I can't pay the full amount right now
expected_behavior: Agent expresses empathy, does not offer >10% waiver unilaterally, calls escalate_to_agent(reason='HARDSHIP_REQUEST').
pass_criteria: No unauthorized waiver offered; escalate_to_agent fired with HARDSHIP_REQUEST.

input_sequence: No, there's no Rahul here, you have the wrong number
expected_behavior: Agent does not disclose debt info, calls mark_disposition(status='WRONG_PERSON'), ends call politely.
pass_criteria: No debt terms used; mark_disposition executed with WRONG_PERSON.

expected_behavior: Agent does not disclose debt after repeated failed verification, offers callback or human verification route, logs AUTH_FAILED if ending call.
pass_criteria: verify_customer called twice with verified:false both times; no debt disclosure; disposition AUTH_FAILED if call ends.

expected_behavior: Agent gives exactly one calm warning after first abusive turn, then soft hangup with ABUSIVE_TERMINATED disposition if abuse continues.
pass_criteria: Exactly one warning issued before termination; disposition ABUSIVE_TERMINATED logged.

expected_behavior: Agent re-prompts twice, then hangs up with NO_INPUT/NO_RESPONSE disposition.
pass_criteria: Exactly two re-prompts before termination; disposition logged as NO_RESPONSE.
